snippet.title: Tomb Raider: Side-Scroller Edition | Trailer [2026 Fangame]
snippet.description:
Classic Tomb Raider, fully reimagined as a side-scroller

The fangame is available for free on TRCustoms.org, a website for all Tomb Raider fangames. Available exclusively on PC (Windows). 
➡ https://trcustoms.org/levels/3883

Developed by Delca and Trxye, it's been a long journey bringing this to life and we're incredibly happy to announce that it's now complete... And we even have a release date!

Here's a trailer showcasing gameplay and features :)

____

Side-Scroller Edition is an unofficial Tomb Raider game made by fans.
Inspired by the original Tomb Raider games.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by the trademark owners.
